result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but one notable visual issue was found related to duplicate restaurant listings.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows 'Green Bowl Poké' listed twice in a row with identical delivery time (15-25 min) and identical delivery fee (€0.90). This appears to be a duplicate entry rather than two distinct restaurant locations, which is confusing to users.
issues.suggestion: Verify whether these are truly two separate restaurant branches. If so, differentiate them with branch-specific labels (e.g., address or branch name). If it is a data duplication bug, fix the data source to avoid showing the same restaurant twice consecutively.
